Package index

Palette access and inspection

Retrieve, list, display, compare, interpolate and export the 282 bundled palettes.

palettes()
Comprehensive color palette collection
list_palettes()
List available color palettes
palette_info()
Get detailed information about a palette
display_palette()
Display color palette visually
compare_palettes()
Compare multiple palettes
palette_ramp()
Create color ramp function from palette
interpolate_palette()
Interpolate palette to specified number of colors
export_palette()
Export palette to various formats
pattern_colors()
Generate a coloring scheme for patterns
plot_palette()
Plot color palette or palette ramp
plot_category()
Plot all palettes from a category
plot_palette_grid()
Plot multiple palettes in a grid

ggplot2 integration

Discrete, continuous, binned and divergent scales for both colour and fill aesthetics. British and American spellings are aliases.

scale_color_koloro() scale_colour_koloro()
Discrete color scale using koloRo palettes
scale_color_koloro_c() scale_colour_koloro_c()
Continuous color scale using koloRo palettes
scale_color_koloro_binned() scale_colour_koloro_binned()
Binned color scale using koloRo palettes
scale_color_koloro_div() scale_colour_koloro_div()
Diverging color scale using koloRo palettes
scale_fill_koloro()
Discrete fill scale using koloRo palettes
scale_fill_koloro_c()
Continuous fill scale using koloRo palettes
scale_fill_koloro_binned()
Binned fill scale using koloRo palettes
scale_fill_koloro_div()
Diverging fill scale using koloRo palettes

Colour manipulation

Per-channel transforms, harmony helpers and HEX/RGB converters.

add_alpha()
Add transparency to a color
adjust_brightness()
Lighten or darken a color
desaturate()
Desaturate a color
highlight_color()
Create a highlight color
shadow_color()
Create a shadow color
mix_colors()
Mix two colors
complementary_color()
Get complementary color
analogous_colors()
Get analogous colors
triadic_colors()
Get triadic colors
invert_color()
Invert a color
hex_to_rgb()
Convert hex color to RGB values
rgb_to_hex()
Convert RGB values to hex color
is_color()
Check if a string is a valid color specification
